description: Combine shapes with the Pathfinder (add, subtract, intersect, exclude overlap, minus back), or make or release a compound path (Object > Pathfinder, Object > Paths, Pathfinder panel)

operation.description: Pathfinder operation, or make_compound_path / release_compound_path. Pathfinder results follow the stacking order as in the Pathfinder panel (subtract removes front shapes from the backmost; minus back removes back shapes from the frontmost)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)
